summary.shortDescription: A single-cell Eleaf regulated mod rated at 100W, 9V, and 30A.
summary.description: Eleaf specifies 1–100W, 0.5–9V, 0.05–3.5Ω TC/VW ranges, and one 21700 cell or an 18650 with adapter. The 30A ceiling comes from one exact-device independent test that measured 29A and identified a programmed 30A limit; Eleaf does not publish that current ceiling.
